title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Trajectory Rollouts for Reasoning RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.11128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A verified reference solution provides a correct trajectory for training a reasoning model. Alternatively, a prefix of the reference can guide the model in generating a trajectory of its own. How much reference guidance should we provide? We study this question through prefix continuation, where the model continues from a reference prefix and keeps the resulting trajectory if it passes verification, falling back to the reference otherwise. Since both procedures produce correct trajectories, we compare their distributions with the ideal distribution, the model's own distribution conditioned on successful verification. translated_title: 在推理强化学习的轨迹采样中平衡参考引导与自由生成
translated_abstract: 经过验证的参考解为推理模型的训练提供了一条正确的轨迹。另一种方式是，利用参考解的前缀来引导模型生成属于自己的轨迹。那么我们应该提供多少参考引导？我们通过前缀续写来研究这一问题：模型从参考前缀开始续写，若生成的轨迹通过验证则予以保留，否则回退到参考解。由于这两种方式都能产生正确的轨迹，我们将它们的分布与理想分布进行比较，即在验证成功条件下模型自身的分布。针对单次续写，我们推导出了KL散度的闭式表达：在一个有界项范围内，该散度随着“生成不同正确轨迹的概率”与“参考惊奇度”（即在给定前缀条件下参考后缀的负对数概率）的乘积的增加而减小。由于更长的前缀往往会提高……
tldr: 该论文通过前缀续写方法并推导KL散度的闭式解，系统研究了推理强化学习训练中应提供多少参考解引导、以及参考引导与模型自由生成之间的权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how much reference guidance should be provided in reasoning RL through prefix continuation, deriving a closed-form KL divergence that characterizes the trade-off between reference guidance and the model's free generation.
